# unecm (bundled)

`unecm.c` — decoder for the ECM ("Error Code Modeler") disc-image squeeze
format — is Copyright (C) 2002 Neill Corlett, distributed under the terms of
the GNU GPL (see the license header in the file). Vendored verbatim from the
canonical mirror: <https://github.com/qeedquan/ecm>.

The Drop & Play tool builds it with the system C compiler on first use and
uses it to unsqueeze `.ecm` files. This file is GPL; everything else in this
repository carries its own notices (see the repository README).
